body: Orchestrator review of PR #329 (dotfiles-T128-gate-evidence-a04, T702, INV-6 successor of a01 to a03) at its final head: scripts/require-crit-review.py reads the acceptance record's machine part as a JSON object between the first two --- lines with the standard library (duplicate keys and non-finite numbers refused), binds the identity triple task/head/pr to the branch's task copy, HEAD and the swept PR, recomputes the S6 searches set with pathlib, checks ledger coverage against every Codex review comment, every badged Codex review body (four fixed tokens) and every audit finding, accepts the optional dispatch list and refuses unknown keys, requires audit_findings as digit-string n plus non-empty reason and evidence when the audit is incorrect, and drops the uv/PyYAML/online-retry path; Makefile and README name ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE; the test module grows by the contract's cases on the fixtures merged in #340. Five Bot threads on the a04 heads, fixed in the lineage or by the merge order. Approved on the final head after the audit.
